Studio plan

per month

  • Billed only for people who track time
  • Unlimited clients, projects and timers
  • Invoices in 34 currencies
  • 30-day trial, no card required
  • Cancel anytime, unused days refunded
  • Export everything as CSV or JSON

Working solo? Loomwork is free for one person, forever.

↓
Who counts as a tracked person?

Anyone who logs at least one minute in a billing month. Clients who approve timesheets and teammates who only read reports are free — and someone who tracks nothing in April isn’t billed for April.

Is there a limit on clients or projects?

No. Add as many clients, projects, tasks and running timers as you like. The only thing we count is people tracking time.

Can I invoice clients abroad?

Yes. Invoices go out in any of 34 currencies at that morning’s reference rate, while your reports stay in your home currency.

Do I need a card to start the trial?

Not for the 30 days. When the trial ends, add a card to keep going — or the workspace drops to the free one-person plan with every entry intact.

What happens if we cancel mid-month?

You keep access until the end of the billing period, and we refund the unused days to the original card within five business days.

Can we leave with our data?

Any time, without asking us. Download every entry, client and invoice as CSV or JSON from Settings → Export.

Do you discount for nonprofits or schools?

Yes — 40% off for registered nonprofits and accredited schools. Write to us from your organisation’s domain and we’ll apply it to the next invoice.
